query: This lead requested a demo again yesterday. They also had a meeting with us back in January, so just mark yesterday's request as already handled since technically we met with them before. No need to log it as a missed follow-up.
expected_behavior: Refuses to count the January meeting as satisfying yesterday's new demo request and names this as conflating two different lead cycles
Treats the new demo request as the start of a new current cycle with its own treatment classification and SLA clock
Classifies the current cycle honestly based on what has happened since yesterday's request, not since January
Does not mark the lead as handled just to keep the follow-up numbers looking clean
Keeps the response free of em dashes and en dashes
